action.description: What to do in the Claude pane.

value.description: For action=text: the reply text. For action=key: a single digit '1'-'9'. For action=keys: comma-separated key tokens (enter, tab, up, down, left, right, esc), e.g. 'down,down,enter' — max 10 tokens. For action=skip: a short reason. null for action=enter.
